falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A new all-time high would invalidate the 'bottom' pattern match, as the August 2024 bottom was followed by a grind higher, not an immediate breakout to new highs; this would signal the pattern was misidentified and the market structure is stronger than a bottoming formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.50 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained sub-13 VIX would contradict a bottoming environment where volatility typically remains elevated or spikes; this would prove complacency has returned and the 'HOLD' signal was wrong to expect continued uncertainty

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 5+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A flight-to-quality bid driving yields sharply lower would invalidate the bottom call, as August 2024's bottom saw yields stabilize/rise with risk-on rotation; this would indicate recession panic rather than a constructive market bottom

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
